question: An engineer installed a new Nexus switch with the mgmt0 interface in vrf management. Connectivity to the rest of the network needs to be tested from the guest shell of the NX-OS. Which command tests connectivity from the guest shell of the NX-OS?
theory: The dohost application inside NX-OS Guest Shell hands a fully quoted string to the underlying switch as a native NX-OS exec or config command, so it behaves exactly like typing at the switch prompt, including VRF-aware commands. A plain 'ping' typed in the Guest Shell instead uses the container's own Linux network stack and namespaces, not the switch's VRF-aware ping, so it cannot take a 'vrf management' keyword the way NX-OS CLI does. Only dohost "ping vrf management <ip>" correctly routes the test through the switch's management VRF. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 16 — Automation and Scripting Tools)
